basic_info.description: Situated in an enviable location in the heart of the Mission, just blocks to Dolores Park and the Valencia Corridor, this modern flat is a bright and airy retreat from the bustle of the city at your doorstep. The open floor plan features wide plank white oak floors with large windows, and a sleek, modern kitchen with dramatic quartz waterfall island. Tucked in the rear of the unit, the primary bedroom is generously sized, with large built-out closets, tall ceilings, and a bright ensuite bathroom. The second bedroom, full hallway bathroom, and laundry closet sit in the center of the home, separate enough for guests or use as an office. The deeded, substantially sized multi-use storage room on the bottom floor is large enough to accommodate storage as well as project space, or a home gym, and has both lighting and electrical. With access to a shared roof, this is a fantastic opportunity to live in one of the most convenient areas of the city, within walking distance of some of the best restaurants, shops, bars, and gyms, and easy access to public transportation.
